scope: Windows development build, real installed Claude Code/Codex/Cursor running concurrently on one shared epic checkout. This is a local acceptance test, not a general hardware or model benchmark.

environment.diagnosticRuntime: Microsoft-signed fixed WebView2 156.0.4314.58 tested in a separate temporary profile only; system runtime unchanged

changes: Bound and memoize conversation rendering; collapsed tool results remain unmounted.
Send an initial workspace baseline followed by immutable patches over an acknowledged, coalesced channel.
Retain one paused receipt and latest state; a late matching ACK resumes delivery directly in Rust.
Remove all legacy Electron app-region CSS, including no-drag on every interactive element. Tauri handles titlebar dragging.
Preserve per-card drafts and avoid erasing newer typing when a send completes.
Present current queued requests explicitly after bounded historical context, shared by all adapters.
Refresh all 29 guide topics with responsive DOM/SVG illustrations and current provider marks; load Docs eagerly.
Coalesce native artifact bounds and preserve bounded thumbnail concurrency with late-success recovery.

responsiveness.measurement: Native WebView, trusted Playwright input. Input/card times end after two renderer animation frames; these are not OS-to-display hardware latency.

acceptance.exactQueuedReceiptCompliance: 3/3 providers: exactly one submitted follow-up each, picked automatically, exact export + test + report matches, final queue empty
acceptance.draftSwitching: Pass; submitted composers remain empty after reopening; unsent drafts survive A→B→A
acceptance.artifactGallery: 35cards settle on scroll; 20inline previews in copied profile,15historical captures correctly rejected by copied-profile capture boundary. All15load successfully in original main profile.

docs.visualChecks: Wide and narrow renderings inspected; final native screenshot captured after fonts and animation settle.

acceptance.nativeSmoke: Passed: real native desktop, planning, isolated artifact guest without app RPC, subscriptions, capture and graceful shutdown.

limitations: Earlier failed cold-start attempts are retained in raw evidence. The first partial CSS removal was insufficient; the final normal157 and separate156runs both passed after removing all app-region declarations and adding native late-ACK recovery.
Some long frames remain: inspect p95/max values; no claim of zero jank or unlimited fleet size.
Models had equivalent small dedicated coding tasks; this does not establish quality on arbitrary repositories.
Prompt text size reductions were measured separately; provider token usage was not benchmarked in this UI test.
